header.property: GA4 property for a B2B SaaS marketing site

measurement.check: Signup host is in the property
measurement.evidence: hostName in the last 30 days: example.com, www.example.com (380 and 23 sessions). The signup host app.example.com never appears, so nothing after the click reaches this property.

7 event names fired in the 30 days (page views, session starts, first visits, engagement, scrolls, outbound clicks, plus 1 custom event). None is sign_up, login, form_start, form_submit or generate_lead.
sign_up is one of 12 key events, but it never fired in the window, so it counts nothing.
Outbound clicks are on for the marketing site's stream, yet clicks to the signup URL: 0 rows in 30 days, 0 in 90 days. Over 13 months: 6 clicks from 3 pages, the last in 2026-03.
Form interactions are on, but no form_start or form_submit in the window. The signup form is on the app host, which this property doesn't receive.

measurement_summary: Not measured. GA4 sees the marketing site only; the signup happens on the app host, which sends its events to another tool. Clicks into signup stopped being recorded months ago. Steps 2 and 4 ran; step 3's query ran once to confirm it returns no rows, and the funnel analysis was skipped.

funnel.status: not measured past the marketing site
funnel.reason: The signup host is not in this property and sign_up never fires, so there are no step rates, method mix, device gap or activation figures. Signups were not estimated from page views or clicks.

checks.evidence: 4 single sign-on buttons (Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Facebook) plus a "Sign up with email" route.
Email is type="email" with autocomplete="email"; password has autocomplete="new-password".
Shown before typing: the password field's placeholder states a minimum length.
The email form sits in a hidden block until "Sign up with email" is clicked: one click.
3 links on the whole page, so no site navigation around the form.
H1 "Heading title 1", a generic create-account heading. The line under it is an offer line about plan terms; nothing near the form says what the account lets people do.
"Create account". (The raw button text also contains its hidden loading label, which is ignored.)
1 unlabelled input pushed off screen and out of the tab order (a honeypot); no CAPTCHA among the inputs.
A "by signing up you agree" line, and no checkbox among the inputs.
Both visible fields have labels (Email, Password).
dom_complete 2,400 ms, time_to_interactive 680 ms, 2 render-blocking scripts and 5 render-blocking stylesheets. One crawl from DataForSEO's servers, not a phone: a rough signal.

page_teardown.summary: 11 pass, 1 warn, 0 fail. A lean page: 4 single sign-on options, 2 fields, a visible password rule, a honeypot instead of a CAPTCHA and 3 links. The gap is the value line.

top_fixes.fix: Send sign_up, with method (Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Facebook or email), from the app to this GA4 property when an account is created.
top_fixes.visitors_touched: every new account; today GA4 records none of them
top_fixes.evidence: The app host is not in hostName; sign_up fired 0 times in 30 days, though it is already a key event, so it will count as soon as it arrives.
top_fixes.who: do this in your app (code or tag); this skill doesn't change the app

top_fixes.fix: Fire a dedicated click event on every signup button, with the page it sits on as a parameter (for example signup_click with signup_location), then register that parameter as a custom dimension.
top_fixes.visitors_touched: 230 sessions in 30 days on the 3 pages known to carry the button
top_fixes.evidence: Outbound clicks are on, yet 0 signup clicks in 30 or 90 days and 6 in 13 months (last in 2026-03). Clicks into a subdomain of the same site were not reliably recorded as outbound here.
top_fixes.who: add the event in your tag manager; I can then register signup_location with create_custom_dimension after you confirm

top_fixes.fix: Add one line under the heading that says what the account lets people do, next to the offer line.
top_fixes.visitors_touched: everyone who reaches the signup page (count unknown until fix 1 lands)
top_fixes.evidence: Value line: warn. H1 "Heading title 1" (a generic create-account heading) plus an offer line only.
top_fixes.who: do this on your signup page; run it as a test once sign_up is measured

tests_to_run.hypothesis: If we add a line under the heading that names what the account does, sign_up per signup page view will rise, because the page today shows only a generic heading and an offer line.

If we show the email field on load instead of behind "Sign up with email", email signups will rise without lowering single sign-on signups, because the email route is the only one that takes an extra click.

If we order the 4 single sign-on buttons by the method mix and drop any provider with almost no use, signups will rise, because this run found 5 sign-in routes (4 single sign-on buttons plus email) in an order no signup data supports yet: GA4 recorded 0 sign_up events, so which provider people pick is unknown.
tests_to_run.needs: fix 1 and 30 days of sign_up by method

unknowns: The funnel (signup page users, form starts, signups, activation), method mix and device gap: GA4 receives nothing from the app host. The step 3 query returned no sign_up, login, form_start, form_submit or generate_lead rows for either 30-day window.
Signup click rates per page: 0 recorded clicks in 90 days, so no rate can be computed.
What happens after the form: the verification email, the first screen and onboarding. The skill never signs up to find out; ask the owner.
What a phone shows above the fold, and lab mobile speed: the optional screenshot and PageSpeed Insights calls returned connection errors when this was built.
